item.title: github: EMU deletions fix
item.description:
GitHub fixed an issue where some Enterprise Managed User accounts deprovisioned via SCIM between June 1 and June 13, 2026 were deleted instead of being suspended and obfuscated. The notice describes the incorrect deletion behavior and the correction.

  • Source: GitHub
